description: Install MDX pipeline dependencies and configure Next.js for MDX rendering. Move/remove the existing /docs operator guide that leaks internal tech stack info. Update proxy.ts to allow /docs paths publicly.
steps: Install packages: @next/mdx @mdx-js/react @mdx-js/loader rehype-slug rehype-autolink-headings remark-gfm rehype-pretty-code shiki (for code highlighting in docs). Run: npm install @next/mdx @mdx-js/react @mdx-js/loader rehype-slug rehype-autolink-headings remark-gfm rehype-pretty-code shiki

Update next.config.mjs to wrap the config with withMDX from @next/mdx. Configure MDX to use rehype-slug, rehype-autolink-headings, remark-gfm, rehype-pretty-code. Set pageExtensions to include 'mdx'. Keep existing Sentry and bundle-analyzer wrappers intact.

Delete app/docs/page.tsx entirely (it imports DocsClient which leaks PostgreSQL/Vercel info). The operator guide content belongs behind auth at /tenant/docs/ops or similar - but for now just remove the public /docs/page.tsx.

In proxy.ts, the PUBLIC_PATHS array already has '/docs' which works as a prefix match since isPublic() checks pathname.startsWith(p + '/'). Verify this and confirm /docs/anything will pass through. No change needed if isPublic already handles prefix matching.
Create app/(marketing)/docs/ directory for the public documentation that will live under the marketing layout.

Add a TypeScript declaration file at types/mdx.d.ts: declare module '*.mdx' { import type { ComponentType } from 'react'; const component: ComponentType; export default component; } - OR verify if @mdx-js/react already provides types.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes without errors for the MDX packages
next.config.mjs includes MDX configuration with rehype-slug, remark-gfm
app/docs/page.tsx no longer exists (operator guide removed from public)
proxy.ts PUBLIC_PATHS allows /docs and all sub-paths
app/(marketing)/docs/ directory exists ready for documentation pages
TypeScript can compile .mdx files without errors (pageExtensions includes mdx)
verification: Run typecheck: export NVM_DIR='/root/.nvm' && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2 && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty
findings: All steps completed successfully. Needed to delete .next/types to clear stale type references from removed app/docs/page.tsx. Pre-commit hooks require nvm to be sourced (export NVM_DIR='/root/.nvm' && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"). TypeScript compiles cleanly after removing stale .next/types. The MDX wrapper is applied as the innermost wrapper before Sentry and bundle-analyzer.
